intent.zh-CN: Floe 主工程和自研组件保持 MPL-2.0；第三方保留实际许可；不因接入引擎要求整款 App 改用 GPL 或增加用途限制。
intent.en: Keep Floe and its authored components under MPL-2.0, retain actual third-party terms, and avoid required whole-App GPL relicensing or extra use restrictions.

rules: Review actual selected versions, license texts and transitive runtime contents, not package metadata alone.
Keep upstream copyrights, notices, license texts and modifications/source/relink obligations where applicable.
Distinguish native host code, independently distributed runtime programs, external build tools, original starter content, and user-created/imported games.
A plugin, separate file, download or WebAssembly boundary alone does not prove licensing independence.
Do not relabel third-party source MPL-2.0 or alter other contributors license terms.
User-imported game files/assets retain their licenses and remain whole-tree importable. This distribution review is not an import or editing permission gate.
Apple compliance and upstream licensing are separate requirements; component compilation and runtime tests do not prove App Store approval.
Rebuilt game artifacts must retain applicable original project notices; generated scaffold licensing is scoped only to Floe-authored code, never blanket-assigned to imported content.
Prefer artifact layouts with separate readable MPL support source and original game source/data files; do not silently change existing license terms to remove file-boundary ambiguity.
